text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Remedial class is done~! Let's hurry 
to the cafe and have some tea with 
everyone~♪

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight, we're not done just yet~. A 
pop quiz at the end. Show me the fruits of 
your labor today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Teach! I'm gonna get every 
single question right, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~! Uhh...! ...Did we even learn this 
in class!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Struggling immensely with the quiz, Mejiro 
Palmer was stuck and couldn't go home for 
the life of her...
